podcast.title: Influence on Michael Field's Sound
podcast.body: Michael Field actively incorporated influences from Celtic music into his sound, particularly during the developmental phase of his first three albums. These influences were continuously integrated and eventually culminated in his later work, such as the "Amarok" album. "va cogiendo influencias de cosas como de la música Celta."
